t: This is Senate House, the ceremonial and administrative centre of the University of London. It stands in the heart of Bloomsbury, immediately north of the British Museum. The architect Charles Holden designed it. He's best known for his London Underground stations of the 1920s and 1930s and for the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway. He also designed Bristol Central Library, and he created many war cemeteries in Belgium and northern France for the Imperial War Graves Commission.
